column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key for each user in the system (e.g., 1001).
A DATE indicating when the user registered (e.g., '2024-05-10').
An enum (usertype_enum) representing the user type (Trial, Premium, Free).
An enum (usersegment_enum) describing the user's segment (New, Dormant, Active, Regular).
An enum (subscriptionstatus_enum) indicating subscription status (Premium, Enterprise, Basic).
An INT specifying how many days the user has been subscribed (e.g., 60).
An INT capturing the user's age in years (e.g., 30).
An enum (usergender_enum) for the user's gender (M, F, Other).
An enum (useroccupation_enum) describing the user's occupation (Retired, Professional, Other, Student).
An enum (abtestgroup_enum) labeling which A/B test group the user belongs to (Control, Variant_A, Variant_B).

JSONB column. Stores user-related preferences and feedback details, including interests, activity level, and satisfaction metrics.
Fields: {"activity_level":"An enum (useractivitylevel_enum) describing the user's activity level (Low, High, Medium).","feedback":{"category":"An enum (feedbackcategory_enum) describing the feedback category (Relevance, Content, Format).","type":"An enum (userfeedback_enum) capturing user feedback (Like, Dislike).","value":"An enum (feedbackscore_enum) referencing the numeric feedback rating (1.0–5.0)."},"interests":"A TEXT field storing user interests (e.g., 'sports, technology').","preference_score":"A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing how much the user’s profile aligns with personalized content (e.g., 75.50).","satisfaction_score":"A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring user satisfaction (e.g., 80.50)."}
